run_bleu_scoring: run BLEU scoring of generated translations against reference translations using the fairseq CLI
run_sacrebleu_scoring: run sacrebleu corpus BLEU scoring by passing system output and reference files to the CLI
run_sentence_bleu: run sentence-level BLEU scoring with +1 smoothing on system output against reference translations
run_case_insensitive_bleu: run case-insensitive BLEU scoring by passing the --ignore-case flag to the CLI
run_corpus_bleu_with_order: run corpus BLEU scoring considering ngrams up to a specified order using the --order flag
